title: Masaraa Fiixee Daawwitii
intro: Biyya fagoo qabeenyaafi ulfina qabduufi Uumaashee utuu hin taʼin aduu itti waaqeffamtu fakkeessi. Xalayaan waamicha bira darbamuu hin dandeenye qabate dhufa, gara mana murtii kanaan dura argame hunda caalutti imalli jalqaba. Achitti, illusion lafa ija gowwoomsuun ni saaxilama, yeroon ifa ta’e immoo waan hunda ni jijjiira.
clues: Dachii badhaate kan ummanni ishee Rabbiin dhiisee aduudhaaf sujuudate irrattin bulche.
Xalayaan kabajamaa akkan of ol hin guddifne osoo hin taane Rabbiif gadi jedhee akkan dhufu na waamu na gahe.
Mana maree koo mariisisee dursee dippilomaasii filadhee, kennaa erguun nama erge qoradhe.
Gara Suleeymaan dhufe, teessoo mataa kootii beekkamtii koo qoruuf fakkeessee naaf dhiyaate.
Masaraa olka’aa lafti isaa sirri feesbuukii bishaan gadi fagoo jedheen dogoggore tokkon seene.
Rabbiin Gooftaa adunyaatiif gad of deebisuu koo Suleymaan waliin labse.

trial.label: Yaali/Taatee
options: Qurxummii guddaa gadi fageenya galaanaa keessatti liqimfame
Waggootaaf dhukkuba fi maatii dhabuun kan rukutame
Mucaa jaallatamaa abjuudhaan akka wareeguuf ajajame
Teessoo fakkeessee fi masaraa geejjibaatiin qoratame
Waaqolii tolfamoo cabsuuf ibidda boba'aa keessatti darbatame
trial.answer: Teessoo fakkeessee fi masaraa geejjibaatiin qoratame

outcome.label: Bu'aa
options: Kufrii keessa hafee saba koo waliin diigame
Suleymaan waliin Rabbiin Gooftaa adunyaatiif gadi bu’e
Osoo amantoota ari'aa jiruu galaana keessatti liqimfame
Sanbata cabsuu isaatiin gara dhagaatti jijjiirame
outcome.answer: Suleymaan waliin Rabbiin Gooftaa adunyaatiif gadi bu’e

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَـٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ
verse: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh]. (27:42)
